title: Measures to Prevent Cases of Seniors Passing Away Undetected in Their Homes
what_it_is: Measures to Prevent Cases of Seniors Passing Away Undetected in Their Homes

sections.label: HDB checks on seniors
sections.summary: HDB checks on flat owners and tenants, and community efforts engage at-risk seniors through Silver Generation Ambassadors and Active Ageing Centres.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB also checks in on flat owners and tenants on lease management and tenancy matters as needed, or upon receiving ground feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will know of cases where seniors passed away undetected at home, either directly or through other agencies called upon to respond.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The community remains a critical source of help in times of emergency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are existing community efforts to engage seniors who are at-risk, including proactive outreach by Silver Generation Ambassadors under the Agency for Integrated Care, and care and support services offered by the Active Ageing Centres (AACs).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For seniors who are not open to community engagement, community partners continue to use different ways to build trust and rapport over and above their check-ins and visits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We will work with these agencies to consider the idea raised by the Member as we work to enhance community support for seniors.

sections.label: EASE programme review
sections.summary: The EASE programme is being reviewed and technological solutions for seniors are being explored.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, we are reviewing the EASE programme and we are also exploring technological solutions for seniors to live and age well, as well as in the community.

sections.label: Ageing Action Plan update
sections.summary: MOH shared its plan and the Ageing Action Plan, the Live Well, Age Well programme, was updated earlier this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: MOH has shared what the plan is ahead, and in fact, earlier this year, we updated the Ageing Action Plan, the Live Well, Age Well programme.

sections.label: Red Cross HoME+ programme
sections.summary: A Member asked whether MND can work closely with the Red Cross, which has a HoME+ programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could I just follow up on Member Yip Hon Weng's point and ask whether MND can work closely with the Red Cross, who already have a HoME+ programme?

sections.label: Exploring technological solutions
sections.summary: Technological solutions are being explored, as shared earlier.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As I shared earlier, we are exploring technological solutions.
